problem.title: Minimum Insertions to Balance A Parentheses String

approaches.title: Track unmatched opens while processing close pairs
approaches.summary: Greedily process closing parentheses in pairs, using a depth count for unmatched opens and adding insertions for missing partners or opens. Run-length batching and byte-by-byte pair consumption are two implementations of this strategy.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Groups identical characters and handles each run of closing parentheses in bulk, updating unmatched-open depth and insertion count.
Scans bytes and consumes closing parentheses in pairs, maintaining the same unmatched-open depth and insertion count.

approaches.title: Track required closing parentheses
approaches.summary: Maintain the number of closing parentheses still needed to balance the prefix. Adjust the count for parity when opening parentheses arrive and insert an opening parenthesis when a close would make the requirement negative.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces unmatched-open depth with a counter for required closing parentheses, correcting odd requirements and unmatched closes as it scans.
